title: The Great Steak
lines: Mom made a great steak for the meal.
The smell of it went all over the house.
She set it on a big white plate.
"That plate was my mom's plate," she said.
"Hold it well, Tom. Do not break it."
Tom took the plate up with both hands.
It did weigh a lot with the steak on it.
He went slow, one step at a time.
But he did not see the cat on the mat.
Tom tripped, and the plate fell and broke.
It went into eight white bits on the floor.
The cat got the steak and ran off with it.
Tom sat down on the floor for a bit.
Then he got the broom and cleaned it up.
He set all eight bits up on the table.
He tried to fit them back with just his hands.
But the bits slid apart when he let go.
So Tom got Dad to hand him the glue.
He set the bits back on, one at a time.
It took a long time, but the plate held.
Mom said, "That is a great fix, Tom."
After the meal, Tom did the dishes to help.
The cat had the greatest meal of all.

questions.listenFor: He did not see the cat on the mat. Have them find the line.

questions.ask: What did Tom try first with the eight bits, and did it work?
questions.listenFor: He tried to fit them back with his hands, but the bits slid apart. Then he got the glue and set them back on.

questions.ask: Why was that plate a big deal to Mom?
questions.listenFor: It was her mom's plate. It is in the fourth line.
